channel.title: 7News · English
channel.description: AI news: original summaries and analysis from official sources (English)

item.title: Ollama 0.40.17 adds Inkling 2 Mini and Apple Silicon concurrency
item.description: Ollama v0.40.17 ships Thinking Machines’ Inkling 2 Mini (~26B/5.4B active) and concurrent multi-request serving on Apple silicon; Inkling is Apple-only in this release.

item.title: SenseTime at APEC Leaders’ Week: diplomacy and city venues show AI apps
item.description: During Shenzhen’s 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Informal Meeting week, SenseTime showcased SenseRobot, Raccoon Work, Seko video agent, and a quadruped—event demos, not a model release.

item.title: ByteDance Seed STEM: retrosynthesis challenge opens
item.description: Seed STEM molecular retrosynthesis challenge: 10 real problems on Volcano Engine; first prize ¥50k; mainland China only; register by 4 Dec; CRO wet-lab validation.

item.title: Anthropic closes IPO; ANT opens on Nasdaq
item.description: Anthropic closes its IPO with the greenshoe fully exercised; Class A at $83, ~1.127B shares, ~$91.6B to the company; concurrent Class N private placement ~$26B; combined gross ~$119.5B.

item.title: OpenAI Business and Enterprise pricing page snapshot
item.description: OpenAI Business / Enterprise pricing navigation: Standard-seat workspace features, API credits, and custom Enterprise—model seat fees separately from API usage; verify live page prices.

item.title: DeepSeek API: deepseek-flash naming and peak/off-peak pricing
item.description: Call deepseek-flash (V4.1-Flash-1017); legacy names still accepted but billed at Flash rates; off-peak is half of peak; Flash cache-miss input ~$0.3/MTok at peak.

item.title: Anthropic Claude plans: Free, Pro, Max, and Ultra
item.description: Individual Claude plans: Free; Pro ~$17/mo annual ($20 monthly); Max $100; Ultra $200. Max/Ultra include $100/$200 monthly API credits—keep chat plans separate from API platform rates.

item.title: LlamaIndex ParseBench-2: a severity-aware document parsing benchmark
item.description: ParseBench-2 calibrates deterministic metrics to 330+ severity-labeled error types; corpus ~2.1k→4.3k; six dimensions including forms; LlamaParse Agentic Plus ~89.8 overall (vendor board).

item.title: Kimi WorldVQA: 3,500 questions on whether MLLMs recognize the entity
item.description: WorldVQA: ~3,500 image-QA pairs across 9 categories with head/tail splits; measures MLLM factual correctness; frontier models often under 50% on the tail; reports ECE/Slope calibration.

item.title: HyperPod Global Inference Gateway — one endpoint across clusters
item.description: AWS: SageMaker HyperPod adds a Global Inference Gateway—one SigV4 endpoint across registered clusters and Regions, scoring KV headroom, queue, proximity, and errors with automatic failover.

item.title: HyperPod Slurm adds managed extensions for observability and users
item.description: AWS: SageMaker HyperPod Slurm cluster extensions let you declare observability and user-management packages via API/console—validated, kept consistent across scale and replacement.

item.title: llama.cpp b12563 fixes CUDA expert-fallback precision; b12564 tunes Orin MMVQ
item.description: llama.cpp tagged b12563 and b12564: the former sets the per-expert dst slice to GGML_OP_MUL_MAT so requested precision is honored; the latter optimizes Orin single-column MMVQ. Path bounds and how to re-check.

item.title: Foundry Managed Compute goes GA for open-model serving
item.description: Microsoft: Foundry Managed Compute is generally available—150+ open models on dedicated GPUs (NVIDIA A100/H100/H200 or AMD MI300X), plus LoRA and BYO-weights previews.

item.title: AWS ships a distributed KV caching skill for self-hosted LLMs
item.description: AWS: an Agent Toolkit skill guides coding agents to evaluate and set up ElastiCache-backed distributed KV caching—claiming up to ~40% cost and ~80% TTFT cuts in vendor benchmarks.

item.title: LlamaIndex on KYC automation: document agents instead of manual review at scale
item.description: LlamaIndex KYC use-case post: five stages from intake to ongoing monitoring; document parsing as the underestimated bottleneck; not legal advice.

item.title: Codex 0.171: TUI workspace on by default; GPT-6.2 Sol / Astra in the catalog
item.description: Codex rust-v0.171.0 defaults TUI workspace; adds GPT-6.2 Sol (default) and Astra; exec --remote, /rc, configurable undo/redo; toolchain Rust 1.99.1.

item.title: Claude Code 2.1.330 — Enterprise Console sign-in and easel charts
item.description: Anthropic: Claude Code v2.1.330 adds Enterprise Admin Console org sign-in and the built-in easel charting mod, plus fixes for post-compact freezes, WebFetch stalls, and more.

item.title: Tencent Cloud MCP Square open-content reprints need authorization
item.description: Tencent Cloud developer community copyright notice for MCP Square: posts are author-authorized; no reprint without permission—policy note, not a feature launch.

item.title: Kimi Agent Swarm: up to ~100 parallel sub-agents, top-tier research preview
item.description: Agent Swarm replaces long-horizon single-agent serial work with self-organized division of labor; with K2.5, up to ~100 sub-agents and 1,500+ tool calls, ~4.5× faster than serial—top-tier research preview.

item.title: Liquid AI d1.2 / d1.2-ultra land on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel: Liquid AI d1.2 / d1.2-ultra decision models on AI Gateway; Boolean / Choice / Score / Box; audio and image inputs; model IDs liquid/d1.2(-ultra).

item.title: GPT-Live 1.1 full-duplex speech lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel: openai/gpt-live-1.1 via AI Gateway; full-duplex and interruptible; stronger transcription and cross-language timbre; same Live endpoint—usually just swap the model ID.

item.title: Google Dialogues: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI era
item.description: A Dialogues podcast episode: Kent Walker with Walter Isaacson on collaboration behind historical breakthroughs and why judgment matters when information is always in your pocket—opinion talk, not a product launch.

item.title: SageMaker default endpoint checks: latency drift, idle GPUs, missed optimizations
item.description: SageMaker AI monitors vLLM+GPU endpoints by default for week-over-week latency/TTFT, idle GPUs, and gaps like speculative decoding off; AWS Health notifies, side-path benches, humans decide production changes.

item.title: AWS reviews 2026 SageMaker Inference launches (part 2)
item.description: AWS “SageMaker Inference 2026 launches in review, part 2” indexes year’s inference ships—not a single new API; details live in linked announcements.

item.title: SageMaker cross-region inference routing keeps serving through capacity shortfalls
item.description: SageMaker AI inference router registers existing multi-region/account endpoints as destinations; prefer local when healthy, shift new requests elsewhere on shortfalls—no capacity creation.

item.title: NVIDIA DAQIRI: high-bandwidth instrument data straight into the GPU
item.description: Holoscan acquisition library DAQIRI: Berkeley Molecular Foundry HDR EM camera >500 Gbps into GPU; adds hardware packet reorder, ~2× ibverbs throughput, and ~2–4 µs direct-polling latency.

item.title: NVIDIA on the AI infra supply chain: how manufacturing partners keep the cadence
item.description: Ops chief Deb Shoquist on partners from TSMC (since 1998) to Foxconn and Wistron; Amphenol cable cartridges ~1,500 legs at under 1 DPPM; chip-out to system-out as short as ~two weeks when demand requires.

item.title: Lambda wires 10K+ GB300 GPUs with NVIDIA Photonics CPO switches
item.description: Lambda connects GB300 NVL72 racks with NVIDIA Photonics CPO; tests cite ~4% rack and up to ~10% pod latency cuts; up to ~5× power efficiency and ~15× reliability vs pluggables (vendor).

item.title: SenseTime launches Raccoon Finance across five lending-to-research scenarios
item.description: Raccoon Finance covers credit risk, claims, compliance, ops analytics, and research; release cites Ping An due diligence ~30 minutes and statement analysis ~4h→15m—partner/vendor figures.

item.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 on SageMaker JumpStart for private realtime dialog
item.description: Dialog-RSN-1 on Marketplace and JumpStart: deploy a realtime voice endpoint in your VPC; OpenAI Realtime compatible; 16-bit PCM mono 16/24 kHz; ~30-minute connections; English only for now.

item.title: AWS how-to: use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: AWS how-to wiring Kimi Code CLI to Bedrock model endpoints—auth, model IDs, CLI config, invoke path; not a new model launch.

item.title: Claude Code 2.1.329: stronger /tasks, hook trust prompts, and stability fixes
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.329: hook trust prompts, /tasks with timers and /loop, /mcp remote reject reasons; fixes Keychain logout loops, Code Mode memory, and /code-review—same-day 2.1.328 also ships.

item.title: NVIDIA: build Rust tool-calling parsers for new models with AI agents
item.description: frontend-crates: reusable Rust tool-call parsers shared with Dynamo; agents generate parsers + tests; handle truncation, malformed calls, and markup leaks.

item.title: LangSmith Tool Gateway public preview: unified tool identity and policy
item.description: LangSmith Tool Gateway preview: one kit URL for MCP/built-in tool credentials, identity, deny/approval, and tracing—alongside LLM Gateway; works with Claude Code / Cursor MCP clients.

item.title: Skyflow interceptor on AgentCore Gateway de-identifies tool calls
item.description: Skyflow Detect as an AgentCore Gateway request/response interceptor: vault tokenization for tool args, model context, and document links; three Shield modes; fail-closed by default; no agent/tool code changes.

item.title: AgentCore Payments adds Marketplace x402 billed in USD on the AWS invoice
item.description: AgentCore Payments adds AWS Billing so agents can discover and buy Marketplace x402 products, charged per use in USD on the developer’s AWS bill—session budgets and Gateway connector; no stablecoin wallet.

item.title: AgentCore Harness upgrade: Strands defaults and lifecycle hooks
item.description: AgentCore Harness defaults to open-source Strands; built-in tools and context management; lifecycle hooks can allow/deny tool calls; existing harnesses pick up the upgrade automatically.

item.title: Google Gemini 4 Neon lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: google/gemini-4-neon for coding and agents—multimodal, 1M context, tools, Search/Maps grounding, reasoning low–xhigh.

item.title: SenseTime 9M 2026 update: revenue +30.4%, generative AI accelerates
item.description: SenseTime’s nine-month update through 30 Sep 2026 reports revenue up 30.4% to RMB 3.79B and gross margin at 43.4%, plus SenseNova and token/agent commercialization notes (EN+CN posts merged).

item.title: OpenAI’s Performance Factory: Codex agents from alert to baseline check
item.description: OpenAI describes Performance Factory—configurable workflows where cloud Codex agents investigate performance alerts, propose fixes for human review, then verify recovery against baseline after deploy.
